blocking_findings: U1 [Blocking] ux-browser: .tmp/model-guide-preview/real-work.html:33 (the Source paragraph) and .tmp/model-guide-preview/assets/css/site.css:158 (.card { overflow: hidden }): At 390 px the SHA-256 of the source line is clipped and has no scroll path. The paragraph reports scrollWidth 569 px and clientWidth 311 px. The card reports scrollWidth 591 px, clientWidth 356 px, and overflow-x hidden. The visible text stops near `...aa16a7` and the next line reads `generated 2026-11-14.` Spec D16 says the page shows the file name, its SHA-256, and generated_on. The file name and the date show, the hash does not. Fix: add `overflow-wrap: anywhere` to the source line, or drop `overflow: hidden` on that card.
nonblocking_findings: U2 [Minor] ux-browser: .tmp/model-guide-preview/real-work.html (the checker table) and .tmp/model-guide-preview/assets/css/site.css:217-220 (.table-wrap): The checker table needs 1111 px and its wrapper gives 1071 px, so the last column `Mark` (40 px wide) sits outside the wrapper at 1280 px and at 1600 px. The header of that column spans x 1168 to 1209 while the wrapper ends at x 1172. The wrapper shows a horizontal scrollbar, so the mark stays reachable by scroll. Fix: shorten the columns, or move the mark into the row, or raise --max.

U3 [Minor] ux-browser: .tmp/model-guide-preview/assets/css/site.css:217-220 (.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto }): The scroll boxes hold no tabindex, no role, and no label. At 390 px all seven tables scroll inside their box. A keyboard user cannot scroll them and cannot read the cut columns. Fix: give each .table-wrap `tabindex="0"`, `role="region"`, and an aria-label of the table.

U4 [Nit] ux-browser: .tmp/model-guide-preview/real-work.html:14 (nav): The active link `Real work` carries class `active` and a visible pill, and no page holds `aria-current`. A screen reader hears the link but not the current page. Fix: add `aria-current="page"` to the active link.

U5 [Nit] ux-browser: the preview server and docs/: Every page load asks for /favicon.ico and gets 404. The page declares no icon link. docs/ holds no favicon.ico either, so the request is site-wide and sits outside the Phase 1 diff. Fix: add one icon file, or declare an icon link.

Method note of D16: the H2 `Method` block starts with the exact sentence `Route names stay as written in the record, so #high and [1m] variants are separate routes. This page merges them by model.` The rest of the note names the merge rule, the pass rate, the trend window, and the rank rule.

Source block: `File real-work-outcomes-2026-11-14.json, SHA-256 dae855cad4bcd29b0623d8a0b8d4eb75aa16a7ddd6688455735bf312df5464f2, generated 2026-11-14.` All six mandated values are present: prefix dae855ca, 2026-11-14, 1,798 runs, 2026-06-06 to 2026-11-13, 50.6 %, 71.7 %.

Coverage block: Runs 1,798; Date range 2026-06-06 to 2026-11-13; Share with a known model 50.6 %; Share with a result 71.7 %; Left-out paired duplicates 36; Runs with route unknown 889; Runs with route other 3. The values equal real-work.json and preview-1.19.txt.

Run counts on rates: a DOM scan reads 155 rate cells across the seven tables. Every cell holds `value (n=count)` or `no rate`. Zero cells break the pattern. Spot checks agree: checker row 1 gives 0.9302 (n=43) with pass 40 and fail 3, work-type row 1 gives 0.9643 (n=28) with pass 27 and fail 1.

The `few runs` mark is a word: 95 occurrences of the plain text `few runs`, each in its own Mark cell. In every table the marked rows sit after the unmarked rows, and both blocks keep a descending pass rate. Rank runs 1 to n in all seven tables.

Separate tables: the DOM holds seven tables. Table 1 sits under H2 `Producer roles` (12 rows), table 2 under H2 `Checker roles` (29 rows), and five tables sit under H2 `Work types` with H3 headings app code, docs and ops, other, print books, tooling. Those five headings equal the five keys of work_types in real-work.json.

Console and network: the page holds no script tag at all, so no script error can occur. An injected collector for window error, unhandledrejection, console.error, and resource error stays empty after load and after the viewport changes. The network log holds real-work.html 200, assets/css/site.css 200, two font requests 200, and one favicon.ico 404 (U5).
